en: Black-and-white postcard showing a large Orthodox-style cathedral with multiple domes topped by crosses, set on a raised terrace with broad stairs in the foreground. The church dominates the right side of the image, with smaller houses and buildings around it and tree‑covered hills in the background. Overhead power lines cut across the scene. At the bottom left, white printed text identifies the location, and a small logo appears at the lower right edge.
